callback.when: One material completion, remand, changed blocker or actionable failure; not ACK-only. Human authorized callbacks and follow-up directly in the approved plan.

budget.scope: One bounded package; existing root/task ceilings remain, no reset or paid fallback. Reserve waiver does not remove hard quota.

verification: Write discriminating tests first and record initial failure; run focused suite, Ruff lint/format, compile, diff checks, sanitized-manifest secret scan. Synthetic identities only; no host credentials/provider calls. Capture exact immutable candidate, explicit-manifest checkpoint, push and verify remote SHA. Do not claim full-suite or lifecycle acceptance from focused checks.
completion: Actual diff, command results, immutable SHA/hashes, source origins, preserved predecessor status, ALLOWED_NOW/HELD/AUTHORITY_OR_IMPLEMENTATION_GAP and exact next gate. Keep review findings untouched.
objective: Inspect material milestone evidence independently; report discrepancies to Architect. No dispatch queue or substitution for heterogeneous audit.
acceptance: Use existing detailed guide/work-package cards; freeze executable file-level successor only on predecessor evidence. No provider/model calls merely to repeat unchanged holds.
next_gate: Material frozen milestone evidence only; no idle wake.
activation: HELD until named gate; no wake for acknowledgement.
scope_note: No debt source edits authorized by this bootstrap card; existing runtime/debt authority governs their later frozen cards.
